note: FIXTURE ONLY. These mappings exist so the rehearsal harness's MAPPED and QUARANTINE paths are exercised end to end. A real export needs its own decisions file, and the time decision must be the owner's (ADR-004 sampling) — never a default copied from here.

auto_sync.basis: GAP-03 / OD-15 — legacy `auto_sync` means the MetaAPI sync job produced the row; the target CHECK accepts manual|metaapi|import

XAU/USD.basis: GAP-15 — slash forms are rewritten to the canonical broker symbol; contract size is taken from the row, never inferred

fa.basis: GAP-04 — legacy and modern vocabularies already agree for fa/en

leverage_rule.basis: GAP-05 — target is NOT NULL DEFAULT '100'; an empty legacy leverage becomes the documented default, not a guess

time.basis: ADR-004 Amendment A-3 (owner decision 2026-11-18, Option C): the ADR-004 sampling procedure was executed (see db/data-step/sampling-report.md); no real production export or usable host PHP-TZ evidence was available, so the Asia/Tehran standby is adopted as the site-local interpretation constant for naive legacy rows. The standby only confirms ISO-calendar naive text paired with a known zone; unconfirmed calendars (e.g. Jalali/SH) and unknown zones remain QUARANTINED rather than interpreted, per the transform in tools/lib/legacyTimeTransform.ts.

subscription_status.reason: Modern has no provider-less subscription lifecycle: `subscriptions` is the Stripe object (0017: provider CHECK = 'stripe', plan CHECK pro|enterprise, partial unique index on active rows). The legacy lifecycle (none|active|past_due|grace|expired|cancelled, plus plan_started_at/plan_expires_at/plan_updated_at) therefore has NO target; the user-visible fact is preserved in users.plan. Needs an owner decision — MG-SCHEMA-MAPPING.

outside_boundary.reason: No modern equivalent exists for the legacy per-row boundary taint; the instant is present and validated, so the flag carries no decision. Recorded here rather than loaded into a column nobody reads — MG-SCHEMA-MAPPING.
